pattern: 全く～ない（まったく～ない）
purpose: Completely negate a state or action.
keywords: I know nothing at all about this story.
The two results do not agree at all.
I was so busy yesterday that I could not rest at all.
restrictions: With a positive predicate, 全く can instead mean entirely or truly.
mistake: The negative ending is necessary for “not at all”.
